newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Bomb kills 3 children in Lebanon -Israeli sources.
newsitem.headline: Bomb kills 3 children in Lebanon -Israeli sources.

text.p: A roadside bomb exploded in Israel's self-declared south Lebanon security zone on Thursday, killing three children and wounding a civilian man, Israeli military sources said.
The sources said the blast occurred as the man drove his car near the town of Markaba, a district capital in the eastern sector of the Israeli-held zone.
Earlier in the day, a pro-Israeli Lebanese militiaman was killed in south Lebanon by a bomb planted in his car by pro-Iranian Hizbollah guerrillas, South Lebanon Army (SLA) sources said.

In Beirut, a Hizbollah (Party of God) spokesman claimed responsibility for the earlier bombing. That attack triggered heavy Israeli shelling which killed one Lebanese civilian and wounded two, security sources said.
On Wednesday, Hizbollah guerrillas threatened to carry out suicide bombings inside Israel and Arab land occupied by the Jewish state.
It fired mortars and Katyusha rockets at the Israeli border overnight but no one was injured. Many residents of northern Israel spent a night in secure rooms and bomb shelters.
Israel set up the 15-km (nine-mile) occupation zone to protect its northern border from guerrillas. Hizbollah is fighting to drive the Israelis and their local militia allies from the zone.
Israeli warplanes on Tuesday blasted suspected Hizbollah targets in Lebanon's eastern Bekaa Valley, killing two Lebanese civilians and wounding four, security sources said.

On Monday, Israeli commandos in helicopters backed by planes raided suspected Hizbollah targets in southern Lebanon. Five Hizbollah guerrillas were killed later by three roadside bombs planted by Israeli commandos.
